---
title: "Trap: a figure that cannot be read on paper"
mdbrand: {brand: none, style: note}
---

A chain wide enough that no scale brings its labels back above the floor. The
build must stop and name the ways out.

```d2 caption="Too wide to read"
direction: right
n1: Nodo numero uno
n2: Nodo numero dos
n3: Nodo numero tres
n4: Nodo numero cuatro
n5: Nodo numero cinco
n6: Nodo numero seis
n7: Nodo numero siete
n8: Nodo numero ocho
n9: Nodo numero nueve
n10: Nodo numero diez
n1 -> n2 -> n3 -> n4 -> n5 -> n6 -> n7 -> n8 -> n9 -> n10
```
